status: CPU support and unchanged-base validation; current visual acceptance is tracked in gates/refinement-2026-10-02-vegetation.md
method: Actual source nodes/Float32 geometric normalization; actual Float32 instance yaw/lean/scale; all three geometric LOD basal points against rendered 2m Float32 triangle terrain. Dense 60Hz route polyline excludes full source bounds expanded2m.
limits: Static source/support checks do not assess full-scene appearance; hardware review is required.
Route check covers dense path polyline and conservative2m bounds, not an analytic spline extremum proof.
No rock/crown occlusion or animated visual acceptance is inferred from these static support checks.
